comment: Preserved C-first attempt for the A73 force variation. The seed 37486119 and clock 20520210163400 were chosen independently. #levelchange to level 7 emitted six level-up pager screens; the five spaces in this attempt dismissed only the first five, so Ctrl-W was consumed by the sixth pager and the drum caller never ran. The matching C artifact is retained under .cache/A73-logs/ and is not a passing recording. The corrected variation uses six pager dismissals before the same source-selected wish and room approach.
